amateur-callsigns-11-nov-2025.csv.contentsIndicative: header Callsign,Product__c,Status,Type__c,Licence_Version.LastModifiedDate,Licence_Version.Original_start_date__c plus five trailing columns (empty except on 29 rows that carry a stray Excel-mangled month-token in the last column - see anomalies; a UTF-8-with-BOM, CRLF open-data export). 159,895 data rows - 105,716 Allocated, 53,673 Reserved, 495 Available, 11 blank status. Product__c carries the licence-product vocabulary verbatim (Full 61,854 / Foundation 37,995 / Intermediate 14,816 / Club 2,222 / Temporary Reciprocal 47 / Special Event Station 5) and is blank on 42,956 rows (the reserved/available pool). Type__c is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row (the service discriminator, not carried). Licence_Version.LastModifiedDate and .Original_start_date__c are day-first DD/MM/YYYY, blank on 54,179 non-allocated rows; last-modified spans 2017-01-27..2025-11-11, original-start 1903-05-03 (migration-placeholder floor)..2025-11-11. Anomalies preserved verbatim: 47 M/-prefixed visitor/reciprocal callsigns; 2 callsigns carrying a '#' RSL/secondary marker (2#0MVL, M/#PT2FM); 15 Excel-mangled Intermediate callsigns served in field 1 as day-month tokens (20-Apr, 21-Jan ...); 29 stray copies of those same mangled tokens misplaced in the last trailing column of unrelated rows (redundant - each token also exists as its own field-1 row, so no unique callsign survives only there; preserved in raw, dropped from the projection); 16 callsigns with lower-case letters; 3 callsigns with a trailing non-breaking space (G7IWE, G0TQK, 2E1HON), trimmed and counted by the converter; 213 distinct duplicate callsigns in the source (214 in the sorted normalised projection after the NBSP trim).

raw-extract-amateur-callsigns-11-nov-202.contentsIndicative: raw-extract for parsing/reconstruction: byte-for-byte the raw amateur-callsigns-11-nov-2025.csv with only the five empty trailing header names filled in (unknown-1..unknown-5) and LF line endings - a shape-only edit, no data cell changed. Every data row is identical to the raw (asserted row-for-row by the entry's round-trip self-check). Giving the five padding columns distinct names stops csv-parse collapsing them, so all eleven columns survive and the source reconstructs losslessly (the stray Excel-mangled token on 29 rows lands in unknown-5, carried in the ledger).

normalised--amateur-callsigns-11-nov-202.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date,original_start_date; 159,895 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning). Status and licence_class (from Product__c) carried verbatim, blank where the source asserts none (42,956 blank licence_class, 11 blank status). Type__c is required-present but not carried (constant service discriminator). Both licence-version dates rendered ISO from day-first DD/MM/YYYY, blank on 54,179 non-allocated rows. The Excel-mangled callsigns, the M/-visitor and '#'-marked callsigns, the lower-case callsigns and the three trailing-NBSP callsigns (trimmed) are all preserved.
